'''Sam Hawkins''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[November 2001 Austin tournament]] on 3 November 2001 with [[This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|Speed Deal]], according to Jacob Taylor's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3094">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-05-austin-texas-11-03-01-non-flipping-wysd3094/ austin-texas-11-03-01-non-flipping-wys], DeckTech (Jacob "Armaedes" Taylor, 5 November 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-05-austin-texas-11-03-01-non-flipping-wysd3094/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
